reason: Place the blocks on the workshop ground to make the floor; this is the only offered action.
expectation: I expect a paved workshop floor and completion of the goal.

effect: The blocks became workshop paving and completed the floor goal.
reaction: It is satisfying to finish a practical improvement, though the final placement is terse.

mostWorthwhile.text: Firing the blocks was the most engaging passage: the flaking first trial and slower cycle made fabrication feel like a real process with a useful end.

leastWorthwhile.text: Sieving produced graded regolith without explaining why the grade mattered, leaving a potentially interesting material choice rather thin.

surprise.text: The first firing flaked, and a slower cycle produced sound paving; I had expected a direct successful firing.

arbitrary.text: No action seemed purposeless, but after the first choice there was only one gameplay option each time, so I was mostly following the prescribed sequence.

continue.text: Yes, cautiously: making a useful floor from local material and seeing a failed trial corrected interested me, although I would want more meaningful choices and explanation of the process.
